----------------------------------------------------------------------
Bundled third-party libraries
----------------------------------------------------------------------

The mermaid.min.js bundle additionally embeds (via esbuild) third-party
libraries, all under MIT / BSD / ISC / Apache-2.0 / MPL-2.0 terms, including
but not limited to:

  DOMPurify 3.2.x       Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0  (Cure53 and contributors)
  d3 / d3-*             ISC / BSD-3-Clause     (Mike Bostock and contributors)
  dagre / dagre-d3      MIT                    (Chris Pettitt)
  marked                MIT                    (Christopher Jeffrey)
  cytoscape             MIT                    (The Cytoscape Consortium)
  katex                 MIT                    (Khan Academy)
  lodash-es             MIT                    (OpenJS Foundation and contributors)
  dayjs                 MIT                    (iamkun)
  mdast / unist / micromark   MIT              (Titus Wormer)
  elkjs                 EPL-2.0                (Eclipse Foundation)

The DOMPurify @license banner is preserved verbatim inside mermaid.min.js.

For the authoritative dependency list at this version, see:
https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/v11.4.1/packages/mermaid/package.json
